observe.surface: the mitosis command (python3 mitosis.py, or the installed plugin's copy): its plan report on stdout, the one-line JSON summary on stdout's last line, its exit code, and what it leaves in the target repository - MSP branches and worktrees, Lane commits, draft pull requests opened through --pr-command, and the run directory
observe.value: the exit code and the JSON summary's exit, meaning, lanes, msps, coupling and attention fields; the report's sections; the branch heads, commit messages and pull request bodies a run leaves behind
observe.observe_by: unittest for units; for end to end, running mitosis.py against a scratch git repository with stub dispatch, acceptance and pull-request commands and a local bare remote, then reading stdout, the exit code and git
observe.terminal_action: a full run, not --plan-only, that ends with each MSP shipped as a draft pull request through --pr-command, or committed on its local branch under --no-push; for a document, --spec with --plan-only and then --resume
observe.build_artifact: the installed plugin copy, whose python3 mitosis.py --version must equal the version in .claude-plugin/plugin.json and core.__version__; in a checkout, python3 mitosis.py --version at the commit
observe.twin: skills/mitosis/SKILL.md, README.md and CHANGELOG.md restate the flags, Lane and MSP states, exit codes and landing-commit message that core.py, run.py and mitosis.py define; core.__version__, .claude-plugin/plugin.json and CHANGELOG.md carry one version; tests/test_docs.py holds them together
observe.dependent: the Claude Code session that invokes the skill and reads stdout's last line as JSON; the caller's --dispatch-command, --acceptance-command and --pr-command templates; runs resumed with --resume; installed plugin copies, which update only on a version bump; the CI release check
observe.receipt: a unittest in tests/ named for the behaviour, red before the fix and green after, run as python3 -m unittest tests.<module>.<Class>.<method>; for end-to-end behaviour, a scripted mitosis.py run against a scratch repository with stub commands that asserts the exit code and the JSON summary
observe.compat_boundary: a run directory written by one release and resumed by another, which the plan id refuses; the JSON summary line read by whatever session called mitosis; command templates a caller wrote against the placeholders one release documents; an installed plugin copy that stays on its version until the plugin version changes

reach.access: python3 mitosis.py from the repository root, or the installed plugin's copy; needs Python 3.9 or later and git; no credentials for --plan-only or --no-push runs; a real run needs the caller's model CLI, and gh signed in to open pull requests
reach.shortcut: --plan-only spawns nothing; --no-push commits locally and opens no pull request; stub dispatch, acceptance and pull-request commands make a run unattended and reproducible; --timeout bounds every child
reach.fixtures: any git repository with a commit on --feature-branch; the tests build scratch repositories and a local bare remote in temporary directories
